data.body: TDD contract card: authoritative contract is the parent-required durable-infrastructure scope clause plus this story signed four-MAJOR-class qualifier and balanced live corpus. Preconditions: current T10 prompt has no transient carve-out and no packaged plan-review-T10 eval. Production path: reviewer prompt through registry explain; packaged spec through load_eval_spec, calibrate_criterion, and eval_solver. Tier: deterministic prompt/spec contract tests plus real loader/calibration, with repeated live criteria eval for model behavior because a structural test cannot prove agentic discrimination. Postconditions: adjacent exact clauses; no cross-criterion delegation; five benign cases pass; five unsafe cases find; explain and generated guide render both clauses. CI gate: targeted pytest plus make test. Negative controls are the five benign cases; no stateful recovery/contention applies.
